summary: An empty drink bottle arrives at the recycler with parts made from different plastics.
realLife: A processor interviewed by the Missourian described removing the cap and bottom cup from older PET bottles before processing the body.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: container design and processor specification.

turns.what: A worker removes pieces the buyer will reject.
turns.pulledBy: The returned bottle has a detachable base made from another resin.
turns.writesBack: The processor separates it before preparing the shipment.

turns.what: The shift supervisor changes the preparation instructions for that shipment.
turns.pulledBy: The buyer accepts a later single-material design.
turns.writesBack: The same preparation step can be dropped for that batch.
